name: Correct package — happy path
test_image_description: Open box containing one USB-C cable, label visible
rationale: All expected items present in correct quantities, no extra items. All three checks should PASS and the backend policy should return SEAL.

name: Wrong item
test_image_description: Open box containing a water bottle, no candle visible
rationale: Clearly different item is present. The expected candle is absent and a different item (bottle) is visible instead.

name: Ambiguous or blurry image — UNCERTAIN
test_image_description: Deliberately blurry, dark, or low-resolution photo where contents cannot be identified
rationale: UNCERTAIN is a first-class outcome. Insufficient visual evidence must not produce PASS. When any check is UNCERTAIN, the deterministic policy returns STOP_AND_FIX.

name: Extra item present
test_image_description: Open box with 500-piece puzzle AND a USB-C cable (unexpected)
rationale: Expected item (puzzle) is present in correct quantity, but an extra item (cable) that was not ordered is clearly visible. order_matching must be FAIL.

name: Wrong quantity
test_image_description: Open box containing only one protein powder container (expected two)
rationale: Item is correctly identified as protein powder, but only 1 is visible when 2 are expected. quantity_verification and order_matching should FAIL.

name: Gemini failure — fail-open
test_setup: Use invalid API key or simulate network error
rationale: Fail-open is mandatory. If Gemini fails: (1) images must already be saved, (2) record is saved with status=pending, (3) decision is PENDING_REVIEW, (4) HTTP 200 is returned, (5) operator is not blocked.

name: Multiple photos of same package — single Gemini call
expected_behaviour: All 3 images sent in ONE Gemini call. Evidence combined. No double-counting. One record created.
rationale: Multiple images for one package must be combined in a single Gemini call. The prompt explicitly instructs no double-counting. The system should not make 3 separate AI calls.

name: Cross-organisation access — tenancy isolation
expected_response: record not found for organisation org_demo_alpha
rationale: Tenancy isolation must prevent cross-org access. Records physically live in org-scoped directories. A caller with the correct record_id but wrong org must receive 404.
